scope: Generator operand evaluation on Python authoring surfaces for historical Python and native development engines. Source-language expression order is distinguished from runtime skip/suspend rules; no native C++ expression-order claim.
proposal: Evaluate time then payload once before deciding whether the yielded publication is past, due or future. A failed time operand prevents payload evaluation; a failed payload prevents scheduling/publication. Resolve negative durations relative to the running body and skip a representable past target. Duplicate due publication is an error.
